title: HiL-Bench (Human-in-Loop Benchmark): Do Agents Know When to Ask for Help?
verification_method: arXiv v4 abstract and metadata inspection
support_scope: HiL-Bench defines selective escalation as knowing when to ask for help under blockers.
HiL-Bench defines Ask-F1 as the harmonic mean of question precision and blocker recall.
HiL-Bench uses missing information, ambiguity, and contradiction as blocker classes.
limitations_for_use: HiL-Bench evaluates software-engineering and text-to-SQL domains, not research-workflow reliability.
EviGateBench adapts the escalation concept and does not claim metric comparability.
